description: Everything the companion window may invoke. Tauri denies by default, so this list is the whole surface: adding a capability here is a deliberate act, which is the property we chose Tauri for.

permissions.description: Open a block-explorer link in the system browser. Both webviews drop target=_blank, so without this an explorer link is a link that does nothing. Scoped to https so the window cannot hand the OS a file:// or a custom scheme; it is not narrowed to the explorer hosts because a user-added custom chain brings its own explorer, and a scope that silently excluded it would produce exactly the dead link this exists to fix. The only URLs the app ever passes are built by txUrl() from the chain record.
